lines.text: @sai_front runs for the last night bus, the doors close, then open again; the driver waves him on.

new_beats.text: The last bus still waits for you.

writes.note: I added a short VO beat at 1 s and kept your action and direction as they were.

reply.rationale: The VO adds the idea of the bus waiting without repeating the action, and it is short enough to fit the shot's pace.
